text: As at 31 December 2025 the French State held 21.09% of FDJ UNITED's capital and, under the PACTE law, keeps close control over the company.
short: The French State holds 21.09% of FDJ UNITED and keeps close control of it

source.name: FDJ UNITED — 2025 Universal Registration Document (URD), section 7.3.1.8, statement regarding control of the Company
source.quote: As at 31 December 2025, the French State holds 21.09% of the Company's capital. Pursuant to the Pacte Law, the French State preserves close control over the Company
